name: Fairytale Thief: The Three Little Pigs
source:
A werewolf girl is looking for three magic objects. Conveniently, the siblings from a local construction company own a set of three miniature houses that seem to be exactly what she needs. Now what?

[from [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-the-three-little-pigs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个狼人女孩正在寻找三件魔法物品。方便的是，当地一家建筑公司的兄弟姐妹拥有一套三栋微型房屋，这似乎正是她所需要的。现在怎么办？

[来自[url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/fairytale-thief-the-three-little-pigs]itch.io[/url]]
